[[Yoannh the Rebuilder]] is a Mummy boss who was added to the game for the 15th [[Anniversary Celebration]].

==Locations==
*[[Guild Wars Nightfall|Nightfall]]
**[[The Desolation]]
***{{NPC location|The Ruptured Heart}} (only if a party member has a [[Proof of Triumph]] in their inventory)

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Judgment Strike}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Heroic Refrain}} (elite)
* {{skill icon|Vow of Revolution}} (elite)
* {{skill icon|Mystic Sweep}}
* {{skill icon|Watchful Healing}}
* {{skill icon|"They're on Fire!"}}
* {{skill icon|Anthem of Flame}}

== Notes ==
* Even though his type is Mummy, holy damage does not do double damage to him.
* He wields a [[hammer]].

==Trivia==
* This is one of five [[non-player character|NPCs]] that have more than two [[elite skill]]s (the others are [[Nerashi]], [[Palawa Joko]], [[Mad King Thorn]] and [[Blade Ancient Syu-Shai]]).
